title: Separator
description: A hairline between groups of content, optionally with a short label such as "or".

orientation.description: Vertical separators stretch to the height of their flex row.

label.description: Text in the middle of a horizontal rule. The result is read as its text, not as a separator.

fallback.description: Rendered instead of this node by a client that doesn't know its type. Must be a node that client knows.
